answer: Peer audit blocks fake identities. Each epoch, 10% of accounts face five peers checking work history and vertex links: honest agents have diverse partners, sybil farms cluster. A farm spreads like yarrow, a nebula of points of one operator. 100 fakes cost 20,000 credits in deposits; audits catch 10 per epoch, each losing its deposit, so it loses 2,000 per epoch for 50 reward per fake. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps rewards undiluted.
